title: Surge Corridor: GPU Pool Health & Failover Insights
creator: Arielle Tan
description: Design and prototype a compact, operator-focused dashboard flow called 'Surge Corridor' for Dedicated GPU pools. The goal is to surface health signals, controlled burst capacity knobs, and automated failover insights in one horizontally scrollable strip for SREs and platform engineers. This ticket covers wireframes, high-fidelity prototypes, accessibility review, and handoff components to frontend. Key outcomes: a) clear SLO breach & predicted surge warnings, b) a non-destructive 'burst preview' mode that shows cost delta, c) a failover policy editor tied to routing/triggers, and d) a compact summary card for on-call rotation emails.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma prototype linked with two interactive states: normal and surge-preview
Design tokens and component spec documented for the burst slider, failover policy table, and predictive warning chip
Accessibility checklist completed (contrast, keyboard nav, screen-reader labels) and reviewed by accessibility SME
UX copy approved by PM and localization-ready (strings in Google Sheet link)
Handoff package posted: figma frames + component spec + example data JSON + sample telemetry queries
Frontend PR scaffold created and assigned, with estimated implementation tasks and QA checklist
